//: AUTO-GENERATED by ~/.dotfiles/install.sh — DO NOT EDIT ~/.claude/settings.json directly; changes are overwritten on the next install run.

Edit the sources instead: base/claude/settings.base.json (shared) + identities/<id>/claude/common.settings.json (per-identity) + claude/settings.local.json (this machine only, not committed), then re-run ~/.dotfiles/install.sh.
//theme: Follow the terminal's own light/dark setting rather than pinning one. Set here (not left to /config) because Claude Code re-serializes ~/.claude/settings.json at runtime, so a value only ever set through /config is real on one machine but absent on a fresh one.
//outputStyle: The default for every machine. A workspace's own .claude/settings.local.json wins over it (the local tier beats the user tier).
//autoDreamEnabled: Claude Code's native background memory consolidation is OFF, deliberately: scripts/dream runs its own consolidation, and its config names exactly ONE machine that promotes to MEMORY.md, so concurrent whole-file rewrites cannot race a git sync of the same files. Native autoDream writes memory files into the same tree, so leaving it on would put a second, uncoordinated consolidator on the same MEMORY.md on every machine.
UNSET IS NOT OFF: when this key is undefined Claude Code falls through to a server-side default, so without an explicit false the feature can be enabled remotely.
Reversible: delete this key to return to the server-controlled behavior, or set true for one machine in claude/settings.local.json.
//idleCompaction: Claude Code compacts a large conversation left idle for about an hour, before its prompt cache expires. OFF here: long sessions should come back with their full history; the price is one cache rewrite on return. The default is server-gated, so false is the only way to be sure.
//env: BW_SESSION is blanked in every session, however it was launched: a Bitwarden CLI session key inherited from the launching shell would let any agent tool call decrypt the whole vault. Hand one secret to one command instead.
//hooks: StopFailure: turn-level retry of API failures after Claude Code's own request retries (CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES) give up: backoff 15s→10m, 10 attempts, an opt-in diagnostic agent, optional alerts through AGENT_NOTIFY_BIN. asyncRewake is the only way a StopFailure hook can resume the session (its output is otherwise ignored); timeout must exceed the 600s backoff cap plus jitter. See api_error_recovery.py.

PreCompact: background reflection of the full pre-compaction transcript into the reflections store (detaches in ~50ms; compaction never waits). SessionStart(compact) then re-injects the repo's open items via load-memory-hook.sh.

PostToolBatch: context advisor: free below 100k tokens (one jq read of the statusline's context sensor); at 55/70/85% of the advisory budget it starts a background reflection, then advises on a fresh session. See context_advisor.py.
Hook keys must be real event names (the schema enumerates them; one bad key invalidates this whole file), so notes live here. Event-by-event map: docs/claude-hooks.md.
//enabledPlugins: superpowers is off: its SessionStart block tells every session to invoke a skill before ANY reply, which fights a workspace's own skill routing and the Proactive style, and its skills overlap ones this setup already has.
//skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt: Only matters when you launch with --dangerously-skip-permissions yourself: it skips the confirmation of that choice. Remove it to keep the prompt.
